entries.text: Hello, hello![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_00

entries.text: It’s everybody’s favorite biology teacher!\nMr. Jacq here, visiting from [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0206)]NaranjUva Academy![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wow, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. We do seem to
keep
running
into
each
other
lately,
don’t we?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_00

entries.text: You’re here as an exchange student, right?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_01

entries.text: I’m your homeroom teacher back home, so it\nonly seems fair I come check in on you.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_02

entries.text: Tell me—is there anything you’ve been pouring\nyourself into here at Blueberry Academy?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_03

entries.text: Pokémon battling!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_01

entries.text: Filling my Pokédex!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_02

entries.text: Making new friends!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_03

entries.text:
No wonder you’re a Champion Rank Trainer!\c
I’d bet you can really go all out against your
opponents at a top-ranked school like this one.
You are one lucky kid![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04

entries.text:
Wow, really? That makes your old biology
teacher awfully happy to hear.\c
So even in this new land, you’re doing your best
to toss those Poké Balls and never give up.
How about that![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04b

entries.text:
Wow! Have you already made a ton of new
friends here?\c
I hope you’ll introduce me to them when you
have the chance.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04c

entries.text: Honestly, I was fairly worried about how you\nmight be doing. Unlike that school trip you\r\njoined, this time you came all on your own.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_05

entries.text: But it looks like you’re having a Wailmer of a\ntime here, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_06

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, I was meaning to ask you something,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
What kind of Pokédex app are you using out
there in the Terarium?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_00

entries.text: There’s a Blueberry Pokédex!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_01

entries.text: Want me to just show you?
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Wow! No way! Someone went and modded my\nPokédex app?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_01

entries.text: Of course, I did make the app open-source so\nanyone could add to it if they saw fit...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_02

entries.text: But who made this Blueberry Pokédex update?\nThe notes here say...a Mr. Cyrano?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_03

entries.text: Hmm, now that’s curious. The way this Cyrano\nwrites his code is very similar to Director Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_04

entries.text: And I feel like I’ve heard the name Cyrano...\nsomewhere. Hmmm. But where?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_05

entries.text: Well...no matter who he is, he did a nice job with\nthis update. Thanks for filling me in about it![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_06

entries.text: Hello, hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_00

entries.text: Guess what! I went ahead and downloaded that\nBlueberry Pokédex update for myself too.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_01

entries.text: That’s great!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Now we match!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_02

entries.text: It really is! I like the design the developer went\nwith. So blue and cool.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02

entries.text: Hehe... I do like to keep up with my students,\nyou know.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02b

entries.text: Now I’m on fire with the desire to complete this\nnew Pokédex! I’m so excited that I’ve been\r\nrunning all around that Terarium they have here.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_03

entries.text:
And one really must take note of the stunning
construction of that dome!\c
Whoever thought up its design must be some
kind of genius![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_04

entries.text: So many varieties of Pokémon can live there—in\nenvirons that suit them perfectly![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_05

entries.text: It’s the kind of thing you couldn’t pull off without\na great understanding of Pokémon habitats.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_06

entries.text: I’ll need to spend a bunch of time in the Terarium\nbefore I can complete the Blueberry Pokédex.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_00

entries.text: Though trading Pokémon is another great way\nto work on completing any Pokédex, of course![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_01

entries.text: Since we’re here together, why don’t you and I\ntake the opportunity to trade?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_02

entries.text: Oh, I sure would be happy to get a Pokémon\nfrom you. I think I’ll offer up my Gulpin here.\r\nWhat about you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Now [VAR 0x0101(0001)] is certainly an
entertaining
and
attractive
choice!\c
Thanks so much for trading Pokémon with me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Just to be sure, you’re happy to trade your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my Gulpin?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Jacq a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Wait, I couldn’t let you trade away your only
Pokémon!\c
Make sure you have at least two Pokémon in your
party. Then let’s talk.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_00

entries.text: I certainly don’t mind if you want to give your\nchoice a nice, long think.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Did you decide
you’re
ready
to
trade
Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_04_00

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I recognize that look on your face,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
You’re
hankering
for
a
battle,
aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_talkto_00

entries.text: Huh? You aren’t? Oops, sorry! I guess I got that\nall wrong.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_cancel_00

entries.text: Well, I’d be delighted to be your opponent!\c\nIt’s nice to have the chance to show off my skills\nnow and again. Here’s hoping I do OK![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Hehe. You beat me! I really can’t stand up to you\nin battle, can I, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: But I super enjoy the chance to see how you keep\ngrowing and developing.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: I’ll be here cheering for you, foreeever and ever![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Those are just a little something I thought you\nmight like. Now we can be glasses twins![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You received a pair of [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Hexagonal Glasses[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)](Mottled)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from Mr. Jacq!
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_reward_00

entries.text: Hehe, you beat me again! You really are a\nstrong Trainer![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: If you don’t mind having me as your opponent,\nI’m happy to have a rematch whenever you like.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
Looks like I managed to really pull out all the
stops this time!\c
I’m glad I could show you that your teacher
has some life in him yet![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: Isn’t the Terarium faaascinating?! What a place!\c\nIt’s like you can hardly throw a Poké Ball without\nhitting a Pokémon you can’t find at all in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
It’s so fun to get to pop around to all these
different regions lately.\c
I zone out the whole time we’re flying, and then
I’m just there before I know it! Nice and easy![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
Oops. I forgot to change out of my sandals for
this visit...\c
I’ll get yelled at for sure if Director Clavell sees
me walking around someone else’s school like
I’m on vacation at the beach...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)],
that
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
of
yours
is
such
a
unique
character!\c
I can’t wait to see how it will continue to grow![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_03

entries.text: The Gulpin I traded you is pretty funny, right?\c\nShe’s a real glutton, so she wastes no time in\ngobbling Berries right down![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_04
